name: Claroid Pharmaceuticals Limited
description: Our Manufacturing Facility is dedicated to the manufacture of tablets, capsules and ointments while incorporating production, quality control, warehousing, utilities and supporting infrastructure. Our Manufacturing Facility has an effective annual manufacturing capacity of 14,400 lakhs tablets, 9,360 lakhs capsules and 120 lakhs ointment. We focus on quality, regulatory compliances, new product development and export-oriented growth.

objects.purpose: Funding of capital expenditure requirement for setting up of the Proposed Plant

top_risks: We derive a substantial portion of our revenue from operations from the export of our products to Nigeria being ₹12,934.06 Lakh, ₹6,672.53 Lakh and ₹6,004.05 Lakh constituting 76.21%, 66.93% and 95.30% of revenue from operations for Fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
Our manufacturing facility is subject to periodic inspections by regulatory authorities, and any failure to comply with GMP regulations could disrupt operations.
We depend on third-party suppliers for raw materials and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs).
